runs.question: Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
runs.answer:
[Turn 1 | session=ses_091390cffffePGlP3hNuZ6c9xJ] Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
Here are the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet on 20 June 2026 (UTC) — the earliest 50 slots shown:

| Slot | Slot Start (UTC) | First Seen (ms after slot start) | Nodes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 14590799 | 2026-06-20 00:00:11 | 1,773 ms | 157 |
| 14590800 | 2026-06-20 00:00:23 | 3,142 ms | 157 |
| 14590801 | 2026-06-20 00:00:35 | 1,609 ms | 157 |
| 14590802 | 2026-06-20 00:00:47 | 1,732 ms | 157 |
| 14590803 | 2026-06-20 00:00:59 | 3,188 ms | 157 |
| 14590804 | 2026-06-20 00:01:11 | 1,337 ms | 157 |
| 14590805 | 2026-06-20 00:01:23 | 1,502 ms | 157 |
| 14590806 | 2026-06-20 00:01:35 | 1,336 ms | 157 |
| 14590807 | 2026-06-20 00:01:47 | 1,307 ms | 157 |
| 14590808 | 2026-06-20 00:01:59 | 2,713 ms | 157 |
| ... | ... | ... | ... |
| **14590831** | **2026-06-20 00:06:35** | **367 ms** (fastest) | **157** |

The data comes from `mainnet.fct_block_first_seen_by_node` in the `clickhouse-refined` datasource (xatu-cbt dataset). `first_seen_ms` is `MIN(seen_slot_start_diff)` — the earliest time any sentry node observed the block, measured in milliseconds from the slot start wall clock. 156–157 distinct nodes observed each block.

The full day covers slots ~14,590,799 through ~14,616,374 (~7,200 slots total at 12s intervals). Fastest arrivals were ~367ms; typical first-seen was 1–3 seconds after slot start.
